title: liriodendron tulipifera subsp. obtusilobum
intro: Liriodendron tulipifera subsp. obtusilobum, commonly known as the Tulip Poplar, is a subspecies of deciduous tree native to eastern North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Liriodendron tulipifera subsp. obtusilobum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
